name: Skills for Education and Employment (SEE) Program
provider: Department of Employment and Workplace Relations
summary: Free training in reading, writing, maths, English and basic computer skills for people aged 15 and over who have left school.
who: Australian citizens, permanent visa holders, or people who meet other visa conditions.
Aged 15 years and over and left school.
Need help with reading, writing, maths, English language or digital skills.
how: Contact your local SEE provider, call the National Customer Service Line on 1800 805 260, or ask your employment services provider or Centrelink.
